verdict.rationale: Rainforest is API-first. Long-lived server API keys, a full Rainforest API alternative to its embedded components for payins and onboarding, an OpenAPI 3.1 spec, webhooks, and a sandbox with deterministic test cards and accounts make headless, scripted use and automated testing feasible. However, nothing documents CI usage or a dedicated headless tool. Missing for 10: an official CLI or headless runner, CI/CD integration guides or examples, and independent hands-on corroboration of automated pipeline use.
